svg.text: K1198 Run G (21G): the join calt hid (ij), font | Plc1m calt-off | v7.2 calt-off; ii/aj/ji controls
Font shaped normally; generated columns shape with calt off everywhere and solve through the ports. Black bodies, red solved joins, blue preset joins, orange leads/tails. 1 px = 1 u.
